observations.body: Denied resurrection is answered by an ordered future. Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead? When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
observations.label: Denied resurrection is answered by an ordered future
